videos.author: @jawhacks
videos.text:
Reply to lilwallywalrus's comment
How to mew
STEP 1
-PLACE TIP OF THE TONGUE BEHIND FRONT TEETH
STEP 2
-PRESS THE REST OF THE TONGUE TO THE ROOF OF YOUR MOUTH
TIP (make "NGG" sound)
(imagine Pressing the ROOT OF YOUR TONGUE to the roof as a support beam for your midface)
STEP 3
-REST TEETH TOGETHER SLIGHTLY & CLOSE LIPS
LASTLY,
-SWALLOW SPIT/SALIVA
SWALLOW SWALLOW SWALLOW
PROPER TONGUE POSTURE
VS
ACTIVELY
MEWING

videos.author: @drhoule
videos.description: Tongue posture can play a role in breathing, swallowing, and oral function, but there is currently little evidence supporting the idea that consciously suctioning your tongue to the roof of your mouth all day will reshape your face or improve TMJ symptoms. In some cases, forcing tongue posture may even create unnecessary tension in the tongue, jaw, and surrounding muscles! For more personalized advice, join the patientient waitlist in my bio 🔗 #tmjdisorder #jawpain #mewing #instituteforths #drhoule
